articles.title: Stronger EU borders needed after Ceuta crisis, von der Leyen says
articles.highlight: 我们必须采取更多行动，进一步加强关键地点的边境管控，包括警惕监测和在必要时使用物理屏障。

articles.title: Open letters about AI development
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Expert analysis
articles.summary: 本文梳理了近期围绕AI发展的三封公开信：微软推动的支持开放权重模型信函、Anthropic对此的回应、以及前沿AI公司员工发起的“为AI发展设定节奏”请愿。它展示了业界在开放与封闭模型、安全风险与监管工具之间的激烈争论，值得关注以理解AI治理的当前分歧。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示在于安全争论不能简化为开放与封闭的二元对立；透明度、集中风险与监管手段都需要纳入权衡。
articles.highlight: 完全依赖封闭模型并不天然安全：它们可能被攻破、滥用或以局外人无法察觉的方式失败。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Open letters about AI development I wrote this summary of the past few weeks of open letters as a section of my sponsors-only newsletter but I've decided to share it here as well. Open Weights and American AI Leadership was shepherded by Microsoft, dated July 24th, and signed by 235 AI-adjacent companies including NVIDIA (see Jensen's first ever tweet ), Amazon, Y Combinator, The Linux Foundation, and (a later signer) OpenAI. It's clearly an argument designed to counter any instincts by the current US government to ban or limit open weight models over "safety" concerns - a reasonable consideration given what happened to Claude Fable 5 !

en.highlight: Relying solely on closed models is not inherently safe: they can be breached, misused, or fail in ways that outsiders cannot detect.
en.summary: This article reviews three recent open letters on AI development: a Microsoft-backed letter supporting open-weight models, Anthropic's response, and a letter from frontier AI employees asking to pace AI advancement. en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that safety debates cannot be reduced to a simple open-versus-closed binary; transparency, concentration risks, and regulatory tools all need to be weighed.
